subject: general
question: What is the sum of the deviations of the values of the data set 5, 6, 7,9, 10, 12 and 14, from the mean of the values given in the same date set?
solution:
**Given:**

Data set: 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12, 14

**Formula used:**

Sum of deviations from the mean = Σ(x - x̄)

Where x̄ = mean of the data set

**Calculations:**

x̄ = (5 + 6 + 7 + 9 + 10 + 12 + 14) / 7

⇒ x̄ = 63 / 7 = 9

Sum of deviations: Σ(x - x̄) = (5 - 9) + (6 - 9) + (7 - 9) + (9 - 9) + (10 - 9) + (12 - 9) + (14 - 9)

⇒ Σ(x - x̄) = -4 + (-3) + (-2) + 0 + 1 + 3 + 5

⇒ Σ(x - x̄) = 0

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
